articles.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
articles.summary: We’re expanding our ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to our frontier models.

articles.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
articles.summary: New tools, practical guidance, and partnerships will help prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse.

articles.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
articles.summary: Explore how more than 1,800 scientists use ChatGPT in research. See findings on daily workflows, reported productivity, and expectations for discovery.

articles.title: Obituaries
articles.summary: The demise of Jensen Huang was the end of a great many things, including Nvidia's long-term prospects, the AI bubble, and the exceptional way in which the U.S. viewed itself in the world.

articles.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
articles.summary: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

articles.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
articles.summary: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

articles.title: Updating our coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy timelines
articles.summary: We’re shortening our vulnerability disclosure window from 90 days to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, and to 45 days for all other issues.
